A1.justification: Both readable 12-page PDFs describe the same SARDFQ work, with corresponding equations, Tables 1–4, and Figures 1–5. Both end with references and omit the appendices mentioned in their text. The supplied PDFs support reliable comparison; those unsupplied appendices cannot be assessed.

before.justification: v3 reports original ImageNet quantization results, semantic-similarity measurements, generated-image visualizations, and component and hyperparameter ablations.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results, including the ImageNet comparisons in Table 2 and ablations in Tables 3–4 and Figure 5.

M1.justification: Sections 3.3–3.4 retain the same attention-prior alignment, localized patch optimization, soft-label learning, and block-wise quantized-network learning. The added SynQ description concerns prior work, not a SARDFQ component.

E1.justification: The supplied results retain the same ImageNet classification coverage. Both versions identically refer to detection and segmentation results in an appendix that neither PDF contains; those results cannot be compared.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains real images, Gaussian noise, PSAQ-ViT, PSAQ-ViT V2, and SMI, including its dense and sparse variants where applicable. SynQ is newly cited but not evaluated. The unchanged references to appendix comparisons with CLAMP-ViT cannot be verified.

E3.justification: The reported settings remain identical: the same seven model variants, W4/A4 through W6/A6 comparisons, top-1 accuracy metric, 32 synthetic images, 1,000 synthesis iterations, and 100 quantized-network learning iterations. Ablations still use W4A4 DeiT-S.

E4.justification: Tables 3–4 and Figure 5 retain the same component combinations, prior-distribution comparisons, and sensitivity analyses for APA weighting, block selection, and patch counts. The supplied semantic and attention visualizations also match.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty bars. The reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: All supplied table values and plotted findings match. For example, Table 2 reports W4A4 ViT-B accuracy of 51.84% for SARDFQ and 36.32% for PSAQ-ViT in both versions; Table 3 retains 62.29% for the complete method. Referenced appendix results are unavailable.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–14 are unchanged. Neither version adds formal guarantees or proofs; Section 5 retains the stated lack of a theoretical foundation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same semantic-distortion and inadequacy claims, three proposed components, and claimed empirical advantages, including the 15.52-point W4A4 ViT-B improvement.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and ablation interpretations match. Section 5 retains both limitations: the remaining gap relative to real-data quantization and the lack of a theoretical foundation.

D1.justification: The supplied implementation details, hyperparameters, NVIDIA 3090 hardware, baseline reproduction descriptions, and code-access information are unchanged. Both defer attention-prior pseudocode and efficiency results to absent appendices.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 adds a short description of SynQ and a pointer to Zero-shot Quantization: A Comprehensive Survey, with two new bibliography entries. Existing references are retained and renumbered; SARDFQ's contribution positioning otherwise remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v5 adds two related-work sentences and changes the author email from jiaweihu to yuyaozhou. The remaining prose and section organization are unchanged apart from minor typographic adjustments.

P2.justification: All five figures and four tables retain their content and placement. Small spacing and width adjustments, reduced whitespace around the expanded related-work paragraph, and bibliography reflow change the layout without redesigning the displays.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves related-work coverage by acknowledging SynQ's relevant DFQ components and directing readers to a survey. It also corrects an author contact. The scientific method, evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, with no evident regression. This limited improvement applies to the supplied PDFs; their referenced appendices remain unavailable.
